name: Cranes Checklist Chart
query:
SELECT
  check_date AS `day`,
  COUNT(name) AS `Total`
FROM `tabCranes Checklist`
WHERE
  docstatus < 2
  AND (IFNULL(%(from_date)s, '') = '' OR check_date >= %(from_date)s)
  AND (IFNULL(%(to_date)s,   '') = '' OR check_date <= %(to_date)s)
GROUP BY check_date
ORDER BY check_date;
